stage0031a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$赤木$$
「...$n,
　have you seen $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$?」

stage0031a_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$n
「Those two, they headed to NERV
　together with $$ミサト$$」

stage0031a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$n
「Apparently they're refitting the EVAs.
　Feeding back real combat data, I'd guess」

stage0031a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$赤木$$
「I see...
　And here I was going to spar with them
　in zero-g combat drills」

stage0031a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Not heading to space anytime soon,
　what with reporting that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　business to Director $$大塚$$」

stage0031a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$甲児$$
「Besides, once the EVA refit's done,
　$$シンジ$$ and the others will be back here」

stage0031a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$赤木$$
「True enough...
　Guess I'll teach you the ropes of
　urban combat this time then」

stage0031a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$n
「Then, $$赤木$$...
　Can you train with me before $$シンジ$$?」

stage0031a_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$赤木$$
「Got it.
　Fair warning, my coaching's tough」

stage0031a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't.
　Copy $$ダイ・ガード$$'s fighting style
　and you'll pick up bad habits」

stage0031a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Their way of fighting is so obsessed
　with avoiding collateral damage
　that it lacks aggression at times」

stage0031a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$青山$$
「Fair point.
　How to minimize collateral damage
　while beating $$ヘテロダイン$$s was our whole fight」

stage0031a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「I think that's the right way to fight.
　That's why I plan to learn it from $$赤木$$」

stage0031a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Our job is to defeat the enemy.
　Sometimes that means turning a blind eye
　to a little collateral damage」

stage0031a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$n
「I'm not denying your way.
　But I'll do things my own way」

stage0031a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Do as you please.
　But if you ever drag me down
　on the battlefield, you won't like what follows」

stage0031a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Sounds like you're in a bad mood, $$カイエン$$...」

stage0031a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Heard it from $$ＭＩＸ$$...
　No matter how much she trains, $$ミコノ$$'s
　Element ability just won't activate」

stage0031a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But even so, didn't $$ミコノ$$
　decide to fight alongside us...?」

stage0031a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Even if she knows that in her head,
　it's still hard on her. In fact, whenever
　she's free, she just shuts herself in her room」

stage0031a_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$n
「If you're worried, go see her.
　I'll start training without you」

stage0031a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's nice, young people giving their all」

stage0031a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$いぶき$$, you sound like a mom」

stage0031a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Wh, why are you mad, I complimented you?!」

stage0031a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$n
「In your case, $$赤木$$,
　you should get coaching on women's hearts」

stage0031a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$n...
　Mind waiting on the sim till $$アマタ$$'s back?」

stage0031a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Tell us an occult story meanwhile」

stage0031a_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$青山$$
「I can read your angle, $$アンディ$$.
　Want the girls screaming with ghost stories, huh?」

stage0031a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アンディ$$
「As expected of $$青山$$!
　Sharp as ever!」

stage0031a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
「Then I won't be much help.
　I don't know many ghost stories」

stage0031a_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What! I heard you were
　an occult maniac, and I was
　looking forward to it!」

stage0031a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　Bothered by $$アンディ$$'s teasing?」

stage0031a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「It's not that...
　What the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ said is bugging me now...」

stage0031a_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$n
「Blood of beasts, meeting of waters, wind's path,
　fire's civilization, the sun's glow, or so it goes」

stage0031a_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「I know a saying similar to that」

stage0031a_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$n
「The age of beasts, water, wind, fire,
　and finally, the age of the sun...」

stage0031a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「This is a line from a doomsday prophecy
　left behind by the old Mayan civilization」

stage0031a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$青山$$
「You mean the world's going to end...?」

stage0031a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What the heck is this Mayan civilization!?」

stage0031a_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「Old century... A civilization that thrived
　in Central and South America long ago. Known
　for its skilled astronomy and precise calendar」

stage0031a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「They divided the flow of time into
　the ages of beasts, water, wind, fire,
　and the sun, but...」

stage0031a_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$n
「Since that Mayan calendar cuts off
　right at the age of the sun, it was thought
　to foretell humanity's end」

stage0031a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「Ridiculous.
　That's a load of nonsense」

stage0031a_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$赤木$$
「I agree with $$甲児$$.
　After all, humanity never ended,
　seeing as we're all still here」

stage0031a_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$n
「What bothers me is
　the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ knew of the Mayan civilization」

stage0031a_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$青山$$
「That black hole incarnate...
　has it come to Earth before...?」

stage0031a_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$n
「I don't know...
　Miss $$スズネ$$'s reporting it to Director $$大塚$$, I hear」

stage0031a_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$甲児$$
（The end... the world ending...
　$$あしゅら$$ said something like that too...）

stage0031a_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$甲児$$
（Could it be that $$あしゅら$$ knows something
　about the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...）

stage0031a_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Ayanami... not here?
　I brought a new security card
　from $$リツコ$$...」

stage0031a_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I didn't know...
　Ayanami lived in a place like this, here in $$第３新東京市$$...）

stage0031a_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I... don't know anything about Ayanami...）

stage0031a_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シンジ$$
（But father... talks with Ayanami often.
　With a face I've never seen him make...）

stage0031a_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「These... could they be father's glasses...
　They're broken, but why are they in Ayanami's room...」

stage0031a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Come to think of it, I heard $$ミサト$$
　and the others say that when Unit-00 once
　ran wild, father risked his life to save Ayanami...）

stage0031a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シンジ$$
（These glasses...
　are they from that time...）

stage0031a_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「N-no... um...!
　I wasn't... doing anything!」

stage0031a_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Um... I was, uh... that...!
　$$リツコ$$ asked me to deliver a card!」

stage0031a_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Hey, aren't you scared, Ayanami?
　Of piloting the Evangelion...」

stage0031a_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I heard you got badly hurt in the last test...
　so I was, um... wondering if you're okay...」

stage0031a_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But it could run wild again, put us in danger...
　We might lose to an Angel and be killed...」

stage0031a_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I mean, with $$赤木$$ and the Volunteer Club
　all fighting too, I don't mean to just watch...
　but still...」

stage0031a_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You're Commander Ikari's child, aren't you?」

stage0031a_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You can't believe in it?
　Your father's work」

stage0031a_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Of course not!
　Not a father like that!」
